decisions.reason: A REF names a theme and not a route, so the spec now says the agent passes back the themes of the route it has seen in --seen, the command only guarantees that a route never visits a theme twice and never returns to a --from theme, and criterion 4 says so.

The engine has no guests or tokens yet, but the weave spec requires counts and links over the visible subset; the walk spec now takes the visible set as an input to the selection, computes every count and flag over it, and has an acceptance criterion with a fixture and a deliberate break.

The roadmap finish line for the trial is the share of offered themes an ordinary search already returned at each setting and distance; the trial criterion now requires that figure for every level and step distance used.
The best route of a theme now has a final tie-break, the smallest sequence of the theme REFs compared as text, so the choice does not depend on the order in which routes are found.

The embedding configuration is now a deterministic input: criterion 3 names the model and query prefix, the command refuses a vectors file or a reply from another model before any lead is made as the search does, and the header reports the model, the prefix use and the build time.
The limit is now a whole number from 1 to 20 and a value outside it is refused, so the lane shares and the held-back counts describe the real result and the format cap is not a hidden second limit.
